decision: Retain action_model as the baseline; no blanket freezing, model-weight increase or formal expansion from these diagnostic results.
verified: Four native days exactly reproduce action_model full-day passenger costs, passenger accounting, feedback receipts, initializers and budgets; all16 Online eight-step shadows reproduce actual training.
On identical factual transitions, refitting slightly improves post-shock global prediction and more clearly improves held-next-packet Bellman target error, primarily through the bootstrap component.

Online trust is higher because postfit replay six-head training error is lower. The gradual negative drift of the trust Bellman target is mostly its bootstrap term; immediate confidence is nearly unchanged.
With actual trust and the existing mixture objective, replacing online neural parameters with initial parameters has only a small conditional eight-step effect on Q contrasts and executed holding.
unresolved: Factual observed-action errors and fixed-target critic residuals do not identify whether the model predicts the correct causal value difference between two executable holding actions.
next_step: A new v7 small paired-action truth diagnostic, before any controller revision. Keep the same two seeds and stable/shock scenarios; preselect the first executable upstream state for each of7X/102X/705X in a fixed10200–13800 window, without selecting by outcomes.

pilot_budget.accounting: Additional simulator diagnostic budget, separate from the existing285-label training budget. Deterministic prefix replay compute is counted separately; branch outcomes do not enter model or policy learning. Missing or collapsed action pairs remain explicit.

paired_design: Replay identical deterministic native prefixes from resident inputs to each preselected issue; use F(s,-1) and F(s,+1), a common current family, common decoder/value draws and the same exogenous seed. After the one-action intervention freeze the learner and continue its state-feedback policy in both branches. Prefer prefix replay to assuming environment snapshot support.
measurements: Compare Online/Frozen predicted low-high Bellman differences and reward/bootstrap components against the actual next-global transition difference; separately compare300-second accrued2*wait+ride ledger differences to reveal delayed effects. Record holding separation, action ranking and sign, line/scenario/seed and frozen trust decomposition. Finite-window ledger differences are not full policy returns.
next_gate: If the one-action causal ordering is wrong, revise action-response/event-state modeling before amplification. If ordering is correct but confidence suppresses it, test a small prospectively calibrated task-relevant trust revision with matched budgets and both stable/shock actual cost checks. Mixed pilot results retain uncertainty and do not trigger formal expansion.
